title: Chromatic Depth Compositor
description: Two iridescent objects float in a dark void. The user sculpts a multi-layered post-processing pipeline by adjusting bloom threshold, chromatic aberration intensity, depth-of-field focal distance, vignette strength, tone-mapping exposure, and a custom RGB channel-shift effect, then validates each parameter falls within artistic target ranges to unlock a final composited render.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with importmap for three, three/addons, and three/examples. Load IridescenceAbalone.glb centered at (-1.5, 0, 0) and DispersionTest.glb at (1.5, 0, 0). Scale both to fit within a 2-unit bounding sphere. Use a PerspectiveCamera at (0, 1.5, 5) looking at origin. Add one warm PointLight at (3, 4, 2) intensity 3, one cool PointLight at (-3, 2, -1) intensity 2, and a dim AmbientLight intensity 0.15. Set renderer.toneMapping to ACESFilmicToneMapping. Build an EffectComposer with these passes in order: RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass (resolution 512, strength 0.8, radius 0.4, threshold 0.85), ShaderPass for chromatic aberration (custom shader offsetting R/G/B channels in UV space by a uniform 'aberration' float 0.0-0.02), ShaderPass for vignette (custom shader darkening edges by uniform 'vignetteStrength' 0.0-1.5), and OutputPass. Create a dat.gui panel with these 7 controls: (1) bloomThreshold slider 0-2 default 0.85, (2) bloomStrength slider 0-3 default 0.8, (3) chromaticAberration slider 0.0-0.02 default 0.005, (4) vignetteStrength slider 0.0-1.5 default 0.4, (5) toneMappingExposure slider 0.1-3.0 default 1.0, (6) focusRotationSpeed slider 0-2 default 0.5 controlling orbit speed of both models around Y axis, (7) a 'Validate & Render' button. Both models should slowly orbit the origin at focusRotationSpeed. When the user clicks Validate, check these target ranges: bloomThreshold in [0.3, 0.7], bloomStrength in [1.2, 2.0], chromaticAberration in [0.008, 0.015], vignetteStrength in [0.7, 1.2], toneMappingExposure in [1.4, 2.2], focusRotationSpeed in [0.8, 1.5]. Display a floating HTML overlay showing pass/fail for each parameter with green/red indicators. When all 6 pass, flash a golden border around the canvas and display 'Composite Approved' text. Update all post-processing uniforms in the animation loop reactively from gui values. Ensure renderer uses sRGB output and proper physically correct lighting.
